issue.title: Maestro: multi-account isolation (nightly checklist A–D)
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Parent: #488.

Encode `docs/guides/qa-multi-account-nightly.md` (#375) sections A–D as Maestro flows with **two dedicated Maestro accounts**.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Human checklist on nightly.

**Expected:** Automated add/list, switch+Settings, no cross-account leakage, sync scoped to active user.

## Scope

**In scope:** A–D (optional E if stable). **Out of scope:** Raising account cap; unrelated bugfixes (file bugs on fail).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Flows green with two provisioned users (each with assignments)
- [ ] A1–A2, B1–B4, C1–C3, D1–D3 covered or residual-documented
- [ ] Secrets via env only

## Verification / test plan

1. Clear state; add A then B → fail-fast multi-account suite
2. Failures → new bug issues

## Links

- Refs #488
- Depends on #489 and auth pieces of #491
- `docs/guides/qa-multi-account-nightly.md`
